# zstd / block_round_trip

zstd's own fuzz target `block_round_trip` ([source](source/block_round_trip.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over zstd (facebook/zstd at 82d322c4).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: ZSTD_compressBegin_advanced and ZSTD_compressBlock must never return an error for any input <= one block.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zstd at commit 82d322c4.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- ZSTD_compressBegin_advanced and ZSTD_compressBlock must never return an error for any input <= one block ([lines 39-44](source/block_round_trip.c#L39-L44)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
